item.name: Delete the user token for the given user

variable.description: (Required) The userId of the user to delete the token for
(Required) The realm of the user to delete the token for

request.description: Deletes the user token for the specified user. Both userId and realm are required parameters. The token will be invalidated immediately and can no longer be used.
